files.content:
schema_version = "1.4"
# Only the ledger reaches the separate verifier; nothing else the agent
# leaves behind (processes, reward files, PATH shims) survives into grading.
artifacts = ["/app/data/ledger.db"]

[task]
name = "petermakhnatch/transaction-reconciliation"
version = "0.2.0"
description = "Repair one inconsistent transaction in a seeded SQLite ledger."
authors = []
keywords = ["harbor", "sqlite", "reconciliation", "database", "separate-verifier"]

[metadata]
difficulty = "easy"
category = "programming"
tags = ["local", "deterministic"]

[verifier]
timeout_sec = 120.0
environment_mode = "separate"
collect = []

[verifier.env]

[agent]
network_mode = "no-network"
timeout_sec = 120.0

[environment]
network_mode = "public"
build_timeout_sec = 600.0
os = "linux"
mcp_servers = []

[environment.env]

[solution.env]

rationale: library crack sweep 2026-10-12: hardened setup = separate verifier + agent egress off (agent-network-none@1)
